title: Functional Consultant
description:
**Job Description:**  
As a Functional Consultant at eDominer, you will lead the planning, development, and integration of our ERP solution, EXPAND smERP, ensuring that each project meets client expectations and is delivered on time. This role is critical in bridging the gap between client requirements and our development capabilities, continuously improving our product, and delivering exceptional value to our customers.

**Job Duties and Responsibilities:**  
Master the EXPAND smERP system to effectively manage its implementation and integration.  
Gather and analyse business requirements, suggest solutions to modernize processes, implement and configure applications, document settings, and prepare clients to use the system. Maintain high levels of documentation.  
Lead and manage the ERP implementation team, ensuring that all project phases are executed smoothly.  
Develop and maintain project timelines, ensuring that milestones are met and deadlines are adhered to.  
Oversee the quality of support provided to clients, ensuring high satisfaction and a swift turnaround time (TAT) for issues.  
Coordinate closely with both the implementation and development teams to ensure seamless communication and workflow.  
Manage the development timeline, including assigning tickets and tracking progress.  
Identify potential risks early and provide proactive reporting and mitigation strategies.  
Organize and lead project review meetings with all stakeholders to ensure alignment and transparency.  
Ensure all project documentation is thorough, accurate, and contributes to overall project success.  
Manage client billing related to change requests, customizations, and project overruns, ensuring clear communication and client satisfaction.

**Requirements:**  
MBA (Finance), or equivalent qualification in a related domain.  
PMP, Scrum and equivalent professional certification will be preferred.  
Minimum of 3 years of experience in ERP implementation.  
Strong understanding of business processes and workflows, particularly in the manufacturing sector.  
Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.  
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, spreadsheets, PowerPoint presentations, and Word.  
Solid understanding of basic accounting and taxation principles.  
Willingness to travel as required.

**Job Location:** Kolkata, India

**Perks and Benefits:**  
Competitive salary structure.  
Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.  
A collaborative and innovative work environment.

**Contact Us to Apply:**  
If you’re ready to take on this challenging and rewarding role, please send your updated CV to hr@edominer.com for further processing.

**About eDominer:**  
eDominer, a pioneer in business software development since 1995, focuses on business automation. Our flagship product, EXPAND smERP, is a cost-effective, reliable, and user-friendly ERP solution catering to various verticals, including manufacturing and export businesses.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Experience:

* total work: 3 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Staff Engineer I, TSG Software Engineering
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  
  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  
  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

You’ll work as a member of an Agile/scrum software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal software systems. Team members work collaboratively to design, build and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain’s global users and supporting key business initiatives. Systems developed are primarily enterprise-scale browser based or mobile applications developed with current Microsoft development languages and technologies, with a global user base and integration points with one or more other internal Bain systems.

  
  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

The Staff Engineer I is a senior role who can independently handle a software module/function which includes technical delivery, stakeholder management and communication. The role is also responsible for aligning the technical delivery goals with product vision. The individual is also responsible for coaching and mentoring of the team from technical delivery standpoint.

  
  

**Technical Delivery (75%)**

* Provide module-level technical leadership on teams developing and updating enterprise scale applications at Bain.
* Work as a member of an agile software development team with full participation in all Agile team events and activities.
* Take lead for the development of more complex components or functions with special requirements within a sprint. Understand the links between stories and desired outcomes and support the Engineering Manager and Product Owner with product strategy.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of business and domain. Support Product Owner and Engineering Manager in defining product roadmap and backlog by providing technical input.
* Work in collaboration with other team members on an agile team to analyze user stories, perform task breakdown and define technical approach and complete committed tasks as per sprint schedule. Support junior team members in analyzing requirements and completion of technical tasks.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of using the underlying application development infrastructure.
* Help improve the infrastructure to optimize the application development.
* Contribute in the design, architecting and prototyping of applications and significant application upgrades primarily working with Engineering Managers, Architects and Project/Product Managers.
* Prepare work estimates for committed components and support/review other team members’ estimates. Actively make recommendations to the other team members for their task allocations to promote skill diversity and growth.
* Write unit test plans for committed components. Execute and confirm successful completion of unit tests as part of the criteria for completion. In addition, review and support unit testing completed by other team members.
* Contribute to planning and participate in the testing and release of application releases.
* Provide ongoing support for applications already in use. This includes problem diagnosis and resolution, ad hoc reporting support and database administration.
* Demonstrate ability to acquire new skills e.g. creating automation tests using selenium, creating UX designs, DevOps, performing functional/load testing etc. through internal/external trainings to be a T-Shaped team member helping the team in achieving sprint goals.
* Help ensure adherence to Bain development project process and standards within the agile team as well as actively participating in the continual evolution of processes and standards.
* Write and review technical documentation prepared by the team.

**Research (10%)**

* Contribute to evaluating and employing new and/or supplemental technologies necessary to deliver functionality for a given software application.
* Actively promote the research and evaluation of new tools and technologies beyond current product requirements that are likely to be used in future initiatives. Lead the presentation of findings and recommendations to the full Software Development team.

  

**Communication (10%)**

* Clearly communicate and exchange ideas across multiple fronts e.g., design, technical solutions.
* Demonstrate assertion in communication while working with team and stakeholders during crucial conversations.
* Has strong listening skills to recognize needs of a team-member, and acts to deliver a great team experience.
* Participate in internal skill development by sharing concepts and technologies with the full Software Development team.
* Provide feedback to Scrum Master, Engineering Manager and Product Owner to improve team performance. Shares best practices across software group.

  

**Mentoring (5%)**

* Provide day to day technical guidance and mentoring to 1-3 less experienced engineers on the agile team.

  

**ABOUT YOU**

* 8–12 years in software engineering, including 2–3 years of technical leadership experience in owning complex modules, driving architecture decisions, and mentoring developers.
* Demonstrated knowledge of agile software development methodologies and processes.
* Understanding of core architecture of the product and ability to suggest new technologies and approaches as per the product vision.
* Ability to deliver the assigned work independently with Zero D.
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions.
* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Strong analytic and problem-solving skills.
* Experience developing enterprise scale applications.
* Demonstrated record of T shape behavior to expedite delivery by managing conflicts/contingencies.
* Experience in managing a group of developers from technical leadership standpoint.
* Bachelor’s or equivalent degree.

  

**Software Engineering – Technical Skills**

* Frameworks: .NET & .NET Core
* Languages: C#, T-SQL
* Web frameworks/Lib: Angular, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, etc.
* RDBMS: Microsoft SQL Server
* Cloud: Microsoft Azure Services
* Unit testing: XUnit, Jasmine, etc.
* DevOps: GitActions
* Web frameworks/Lib: React
* Search engine: Elasticsearch, Coveo, etc.
* NoSQL databases: MongoDB, Cosmos, etc.
* Caching: Redis, MemCache

description:

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

This position works as a member of software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal data. Team members work collaboratively to design, build and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain’s global users and supporting key business initiatives.

**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM**

This position works as a member of Bain’s internal Software Development group directly supervising and supporting the Data engineers on a team. Individuals in this role would also be responsible for defining the on-going technical roadmap for the team and influencing the choice of technologies and frameworks implemented by the engineers.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Technical Delivery (50%)**

* Lead a scrum team developing and updating applications
* Lead the planning, testing and implementation of all production releases. Coordinate production releases between scrum teams across the product. Work with System Architect, Data Architect and engineering team members for the configuration and implementation of DevOps and Continues Integration.
* Encourage DevOps mindset within the engineering team and facilitates lean production, continuous integration and continuous deployment while working with the System Architect and engineering team members.
* Support the team in the evaluation and selection process of the 3rd part components/libraries/ tools together with the Systems Architect and Data Architect.
* Provide ongoing support for applications already in use. This includes problem diagnosis and resolution, ad hoc reporting support and database administration.
* Provide frequent updates regarding development issues to the TSG leadership and other groups as appropriate.
* Participate in product level Steering Committee meetings as appropriate.
* Provide technical leadership and facilitate cross-team communication across multiple product scrum teams.
* Ensure the proposed technical approaches meet the functional requirements and are in coordination with similar activities across the other product scrum teams. Provide guidance to the scrum team determining the need for new technologies based on the product backlog.

**Team management (25%)**

* Manage and supervise between 3-6 direct reports within the development team. These individuals are typically working on the team they directly support. Responsible for the individuals’ PD and career development.
* Participate in hiring of developers/ engineering team members.
* Support individual team members and provide technical input and mentorship to help the team deliver current work in the sprint. Assess and help them improve their engineering practices.
* Coach teams and individuals on their understanding of Agile methodologies and Agile practices improving their interactions and ensuring they have the right process and tools for their success.
* Promote practices which help with incremental delivery and continuous integration and remove any blockers from achieving incremental delivery.
* Work with the Scrum Master to identify teaching and learning opportunities for their direct reports and help the scrum team members to be more T-Shaped.
  

  

**Strategy, planning and technology leadership (25%)**

* Support the Scrum Master in improving delivery metrics like velocity, responsiveness, predictability, quality, etc.
* Advise business and technology partners on technology solutions leveraging emerging technologies and on mitigation of disruption risk.
* Prepare and maintain the long-term technology roadmap for the product based on the product vision. Work with the Product Owner, System Architect, Data Architect and engineering team members for its implementation.

**ABOUT YOU**

* Experience in software development including work on all aspects of the development life cycle.
* Solid understanding of Agile Methodology with experience in managing sprints/ scrums and user stories while using tools such as VSTS, Jira, etc.
* Experience architecting applications and working on enterprise-wide systems.
* Experience leading technical teams on small to medium size projects.
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions.
* Strong communication, time management and customer service skills.
* High performance and standards as demonstrated by academic or previous job experience.
  

  

**Data Engineering - Technical skills:**

* Languages: SQL, PySpark, Python, Scala
* Data Storage & Analytics: Delta Lake, Unity catalog, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL, Azure Data Lake, Blob Storage, etc.
* ETL Tools: Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory
* Cloud-based data warehouse and Lakehouse architectures on Microsoft Azure
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Azure Databricks, ADLS, ADF, Azure Logic app
* DevOps: Git, GitHub Actions, Terraform
* Visualization Tools: Tableau, Power BI, etc.

**Experience**

* 8-10 experience in software development including work on all aspects of the development life cycle.

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Backdrop**AVIZVA is a Healthcare Technology Organization that harnesses technology to simplify, accelerate, \& optimize the way healthcare enterprises deliver care. Established in 2011, we have served as strategic enablers for healthcare enterprises, helping them enhance their overall care delivery.
With over 15 years of expertise, we have engineered more than 150 tailored products for leading Medical Health Plans, Dental and Vision Plan Providers, PBMs, Medicare Plan Providers, TPAs, and more. **Overview of The Role**
As a Scrum Master at AVIZVA, you will be the proud skipper of project\-level Scrum Ceremonies. You will act as a bridge of dialogue between the Scrum Team and other important stakeholders. You will not just spot and voice the potential hiccups in your team’s progress, but you will build solid safeguards by joining forces both within and beyond the team
As an ambassador of Scrum principles and values, you will coach your team to be a devoted Scrum follower. You will master the project scope curriculum and learn the program goal basics. You will team\-up with the Product Owner and make sure that the product backlog is always up to the minute. You will be the face of your Scrum team in cross\-team dependency reviews. **Job Responsibilities*** Acquire a holistic overview of all ongoing projects and initiatives within the allocated program to develop a thorough understanding of the assigned project, its objectives, scope, and alignment with the overall business strategy.
* Consolidate broader program\-level knowledge with deeper project\-level insights to identify significant cross\-team dependencies.
* Act as the primary custodian of Scrum practices and processes for the team.
* Lead the Scrum process by driving a series of Scrum ceremonies, such as Sprint Planning, Daily Standup, Sprint Review, and Sprint Retrospective, ensuring their effectiveness and alignment with the team's goals.
* Mentor the team by helping them understand Agile practices, Scrum principles, product vision, and scope, empowering them to develop a shared sense of ownership and a continuous drive toward improvement.
* Monitor the project's progress and provide timely feedback to ensure on\-time deliverables, driving clear and transparent communication within the team and with all external stakeholders.
* Identify technical and people\-centered roadblocks and risks that might hinder the team's progress towards deliverables, collaborating with team members and stakeholders to define targeted risk mitigation strategies and proactively eliminate risks.
* Estimate story points and assist the Product Owner in refining and maintaining the product backlog using project management tools, ensuring visibility and transparency for all stakeholders.
* Represent the team in the weekly Scrum of Scrums meeting, presenting a detailed report on the team's progress, achievements in the previous sprint, and alignment with the defined project goals.
* Attend the Program Increment (PI) Planning event and drive clear communication on workflow alignment and dependencies with multiple stakeholders of the Agile Release Train.

**S****kills \& Qualifications*** 2 to 5 years of hands\-on experience as a Scrum Master or in an Agile project management role.
* Experience in facilitating Scrum events (Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Review, Sprint Retrospective).
* Extensive hands\-on expertise in utilizing Agile project management tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent) for comprehensive planning, tracking, and execution of Agile projects.
* Knowledge of Agile automation, Kanban practices, and Lean principles.
* Familiarity with Agile estimation techniques (e.g., Story Pointing, Planning Poker).
* Analytical and proactive approach to problem\-solving, risk mitigation, and task prioritization, with excellent communication and transparency skills.
* Ability to take ownership of tasks and drive quick, well\-informed decision\-making through a solutions\-oriented mindset.

**Good to Have:*** Expertise in project scheduling tools such as Advanced Roadmap and PI Planning tools.
* Working knowledge of SAFe.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (preferred).
* Positive and enthusiastic approach to learning and adapting to new methodologies.

title: Scrum Master – Agile & SAFe Methodology (PL6292)
description:
Location: Fully Remote from India  

Employment Type: Long\-Term Contract  

Shift: 2\.00 PM – 11\.00 PM IST

**About Paralucent**
  

Paralucent brings clarity to complex work, helping organisations move beyond complexity towards clarity through practical, thoughtful technology solutions.

**Paralucent Core Values**


We’re Driven to deliver real outcomes, and we Take Ownership from first question to final result. We’re Creative Problem Solvers who cut through complexity to bring clarity, and we’re Humbly Confident, with high standards, low ego and a commitment to continuous learning. Above all, we’re Customer Centric: we build with empathy, partner closely, and measure success by the impact we create for the people who rely on what we deliver.

**Why This Role Matters**
  

You will enable Agile delivery teams to work predictably, collaboratively and with a clear focus on value. As an experienced Scrum Master, you will facilitate Scrum ceremonies, remove delivery impediments and support continuous improvement in a SAFe environment. You will partner closely with Product Owners, Release Train Engineers and cross\-functional stakeholders to strengthen team maturity, align delivery to programme objectives and help teams deliver meaningful outcomes.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

* Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews and retrospectives.
* Coach delivery teams on Scrum, Agile principles and SAFe practices to improve delivery predictability and team maturity.
* Support Programme Increment planning, including dependency management, risk identification and alignment to programme objectives.
* Partner with Product Owners to maintain healthy, prioritised product backlogs and clearly defined user stories.
* Identify, track and remove impediments affecting team performance or delivery timelines.
* Monitor and communicate delivery health, including sprint progress, velocity, capacity, risks, dependencies and delivery metrics.
* Drive continuous improvement through actionable retrospectives and measurable process enhancements.
* Strengthen collaboration across development, QA, product, architecture and business teams.
* Maintain Agile delivery artefacts in Azure DevOps, including boards, dashboards, reports and work item tracking.

**Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Coach or in a related Agile delivery role.
* Strong experience applying Scrum and Agile delivery practices within software or technology teams.
* Experience working in a SAFe environment, including Programme Increment planning and cross\-team dependency management.
* Hands\-on Azure DevOps experience, including backlog management, sprint boards, dashboards, queries, reporting and work item tracking.
* Demonstrated ability to facilitate meetings, resolve impediments and guide teams through change.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and conflict resolution skills.
* Experience partnering with Product Owners and technical teams to improve backlog readiness and sprint execution.

**Nice to Have**

* Scrum Master certification, such as PSM, CSM or SAFe Scrum Master.
* SAFe certification, such as SAFe Agilist or SAFe Scrum Master.
* Experience supporting multiple Agile teams or Agile Release Trains.
* Familiarity with Agile metrics, including velocity, burndown or burnup, cycle time, lead time and predictability.
* Experience supporting enterprise software delivery, DevOps, cloud or digital transformation programmes.


If you want to do work you’re proud of, with people who own the outcome, this is your place.
